input.sparql:
SELECT ?eq ?name ?power ?class WHERE {
  ?eq a brick:Equipment .
  ?eq rdfs:label ?name .
  ?power ref:hasPoint ?eq .
  ?power a ?class .
  FILTER regex(?class, "Power|power|Current|Voltage|Energy", "i")
}
SELECT DISTINCT ?class WHERE { ?p a ?class . FILTER regex(str(?class), "Power|Current|Voltage") }
